notes: Totals transcribed from the labels above the parent-group bars in the official figures. These are weighted population estimates, not raw respondent counts. Verified totals for 2007 and 2011/12 remain null. Their column proportions are extrapolated linearly in calendar time from the normalized 2016/17 and 2022/23 group shares. Only width proportions are estimated; historical headcounts and conditional percentages are not inferred. Widths normalize over the four reported groups, excluding any unreported or unknown-parent category.
